title: Profile budget policy when a source pinned by three profiles grows (design question)
description: Filed from LCLI-698 note (2), unstamped for opum-doc. docs/reference/cli-contract.md is pinned by three agent profiles (verification, implementation, review). LCLI-677 grew it (12 rows in the section 2.1 kind registry) and moved only the verification budget (96000 to 96400), leaving the implementation over-capacity warning in place and widening its deficit from about 481 to about 1063 over the 108000 budget; the review budget 63000 absorbed the growth. QUESTION: should each profile budget move whenever a pinned source grows, or does a source pinned by three profiles argue for something else -- a shared budget rule, or a warning the change author is expected to resolve? UNSTAMPED: no assignee, no acceptance criteria; opum-doc decides.
